coverage: complete — one record per new place photo
coverage_note: Every image in this PR is a real photograph, vendored under public/images/places/ as WebP (1280px wide, quality 78, converted from the Commons original with ffmpeg). Licence + creator are each file's own live Wikimedia Commons metadata (imageinfo extmetadata), verified 2026-10-28, and each download's SHA-1 was matched against the Commons API value before conversion. Every image was also viewed before use to confirm it shows its subject. Each photo renders WITH its credit line under the place hero (place.imageCredit). No hotlinks, no stock without a licence record, no invented attribution. Following the homepage-imagery precedent, this standalone subject file is the record; the 2026-10-22 flat index.json is not rewritten.
